question.prompt:
Which of the following is equal to the product

\[ \begin{aligned} &\dfrac{8}{4} \cdot \dfrac{12}{8} \cdot \dfrac{16}{12} \cdots \dfrac{4n+4}{4n} \\ &\quad \cdots \dfrac{2008}{2004}? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.explanation:
Each numerator except the last is the denominator of the next fraction. Thus every number from \(8\) through \(2004\) appearing in the product cancels once above and once below. All these numbers are positive, so the cancellations are valid. Only the first denominator, \(4\), and the last numerator, \(2008\), remain:
\[
\frac84\cdot\frac{12}{8}\cdot\frac{16}{12}\cdots\frac{2008}{2004}
=\frac{2008}{4}=502.
\]
The answer is \(502\), choice \(B\).
solutions.title: Cancel matching factors
